changelog:
Initial public release of the contract-management skill suite.

- Provides a comprehensive contract management toolkit with six core sub-skills: NDA fast screening, contract tracker/reminders, contract comparison, contract review, legal lookup, and contract drafting.
- All sub-skills process via a standardized workflow: intent recognition, sub-skill routing, template loading (from references), strict template-based execution, and quality-controlled output.
- Features built-in routing logic to uniquely map user requests to the appropriate sub-skill, with clear disambiguation between similar intents (e.g., NDA screening vs. general contract review).
- Adopts a unified six-step closed-loop workflow aligning with digital workforce standards, including role assignments (control, analysis, production, compliance).
- Integrates comprehensive quality and acceptance criteria covering legal compliance, risk grading, and traceability.
- Includes Word formatting specifications for all contract-type document outputs to ensure professional standards.
